name: mass_preservation_recovered_diagnostic_v1
intervention: Load each existing recovery adapter and learned bandwidth unchanged, overriding only the recorded raw-alpha readout with prefix-mass preservation.
retention_policy: Evaluate and retain every listed seed. This diagnoses operator compatibility and is not a final recovery estimate.
decision_rule: If all seeds improve without new training, test the corrected readout on a separately frozen confirmation cohort before deciding whether retraining is necessary.
